notes.title: v0.7 - Visual and movements improvement
notes.notes:
The version 0.7 of Rogue'n Roll is now live !
All the environnements have been redone in a much more stylish style :D
The game looks now a lot better, a new trailer and screenshots will come soon to update the Steam store page.

This update also change a few things on game mechanisms.
Monsters now spawn closer to the player and reach him quicker. They also are more reactive and track the player more easily.
The movement physic of the player has been redone to feel much smoother.

notes.title: v0.6 - UI Update
notes.notes:
The version 0.6 of the game is now live.
UI and HUD has been completely redone in this update, focusing on clearer information.
The update also include some new gore effects and a lot of other little improvements.


A lot of things still have to be done, see you on the next update !

I hope being able to update the game for years, and i also hope you will enjoy it.

Stay tuned girls and guys !
